data.name: Paul
data.gender_notes: Paul is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Humble servant, small in stature but great in spirit. The name Paul carries the meaning “Small, humble” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Paul usually hope their child will grow to embody small, humble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes Humility and Service and Apostolic in Christian faith.
data.etymology: Paul belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Small, humble.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Paul total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
